function.name: acl_api_add_mapping
function.description: Adds an Access Control List (ACL) mapping to define permissions for a user or group. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal_id.description: The unique identifier for the user or group.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource for which access is being defined.

function.name: acl_api_AclApi_retrieve_projects
function.description: Retrieve the list of projects assigned to a specified team, with options to exclude inactive projects and/or only include root projects. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the team for which to retrieve project mappings.

function.name: analysis_api_AnalysisApi_retrieve_analysis
function.description: Retrieves the trail of analysis actions for a given vulnerability within a specified component of a project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project.description: The UUID of the project to retrieve the analysis from. For example, '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000'.

component.description: The UUID of the component associated with the analysis. For example, '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001'.

vulnerability.description: The UUID of the vulnerability to retrieve the analysis trail for. For example, '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002'.
